bio.text: Jeffrey Dinowitz was elected to the New York State Assembly on February 15, 1994, and represents the 81st Assembly District in the Bronx, which includes Riverdale, Kingsbridge and Wakefield.
He chairs the Assembly Committee on Codes and previously served as an Administrative Law Judge for New York State.
Born in 1954, he has lived in the Bronx all his life and graduated from Brooklyn Law School, Lehman College and the Bronx High School of Science.
